mobile_first_design.viewport: Optimized for mobile touchscreens (iPhone/Android) with collapsible bottom drawer/tabs navigation and swipe-ready panels, transitioning seamlessly into high-density 3-column cockpit on desktop (>=1024px)
mobile_first_design.touch_targets: Minimum 44px on all buttons, triggers, channel toggles, and chat inputs
mobile_first_design.mobile_navigation: Sticky top brand header with PT/EN + Theme toggle + quick status pill, plus a bottom quick-switch action bar for [Cockpit, Sala dos Agentes, Fila de Tarefas, Linha Direta com Zero, Canais]

theme_strategy.user_preference: light & clean productivity (claro e limpo, estilo app de produtividade)
theme_strategy.aesthetic_direction: Swiss-Productivity Hybrid + Tactical Clarity — Crisp off-white surfaces, subtle slate borders, electric cobalt and warm ochre accents representing agent intelligence states, dense yet breathable operational command hierarchy

rules.headings: Outfit Variable with tracking-tight and font-semibold or font-bold
rules.body: Plus Jakarta Sans Variable with leading-relaxed and tracking-normal
rules.code_and_logs: JetBrains Mono Variable for delegation payloads, timestamps, token counts, and API telemetry
rules.subtitles: Never jump more than 2 Tailwind steps between headings and subtext

entry_surfaces./: Branded mobile-ready command cockpit — persistent top navigation with bilingual PT/EN toggle & AI brain status bar, responsive 3-column operational layout with interactive Agent Hierarchy tree (Left), Real-time Central Shared Room Stream & Mission Dispatcher (Center), and Live Task Queue with Configurable External Channels & Zero Direct Chat (Right)

visual_enhancers.tactical_borders: 1px crisp solid borders with 8px radius (rounded-lg) for dashboard panels
visual_enhancers.agent_pulse_indicators: Subtle green/blue ping animation on active agents working on delegated tasks
visual_enhancers.hierarchy_connector_lines: Subtle SVG branched hierarchy lines (Zero -> Pro -> [Jarvis, Aluna, Plus]) showing delegation flow with animated signal pulses

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_mode: Density + scanability (MODE B High Density) with Mobile-first touch tabs
grids_and_layouts.main_grid: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 sm:gap-5 p-3 sm:p-6 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto pb-20 lg:pb-6
grids_and_layouts.tabs_organization: Clean secondary tabs for switching views between 'Overview Cockpit', 'Sala Compartilhada (All-Hands Stream)', 'Zero Direct Line (Espaço Dedicado)', 'Canais & Web Search', and 'Logs de Delegação'

motion.delegation_events: Staggered fade-in & slide-up using motion/react when a new delegation event is dispatched from Zero to Pro and down to worker agents
motion.status_pills: Transition ease-out 0.2s on status changes (queued -> working -> done)
motion.message_stream: Smooth auto-scroll down on incoming agent messages in the Shared Room
motion.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion; disable intensive animation loops for users with reduced motion preferences

accessibility.wcag_compliance: WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 text-to-background contrast on all panels and agent badges
accessibility.focus_states: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:outline-none on all inputs and buttons
accessibility.aria_roles: aria-live='polite' on stream container for screen readers reading live delegation activities
accessibility.testing_attributes: data-testid attributes on every interactive element (e.g. data-testid='mission-input', data-testid='dispatch-mission-btn', data-testid='agent-card-zero', data-testid='channel-whatsapp-toggle', data-testid='lang-toggle-btn')

logos_and_badges.description: Zero, Pro, Jarvis, Aluna, Plus customized SVG avatars generated dynamically with distinct gradients and glowing AI badges

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME & TYPOGRAPHY: In frontend/src/index.css, import '@fontsource-variable/outfit' and '@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans'. Configure --font-heading: 'Outfit Variable', sans-serif and --font-sans: 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif. Default to clean, modern Light Mode with sharp slate borders and high contrast.

2. MOBILE-FIRST & RESPONSIVE LAYOUT: Implement responsive layouts with touch-friendly 44px+ hit areas and a bottom navigation bar on mobile viewports (<1024px) that lets the user switch between Cockpit, Sala Compartilhada, Tarefas, Linha Direta com Zero, and Canais.

3. AGENT ARCHITECTURE & ORCHESTRATION: Implement the 5 distinct agents with their exact hierarchy as requested: Zero (Supreme Commander) -> Pro (Tactical Right-Hand) -> [Jarvis (Simple tasks/calc), Aluna (Web manager), Plus (Simpler Pro/analysis)]. Include Chefe/Boss as human user.

4. REAL-TIME MULTI-AGENT ENGINE: In backend, create models and endpoints for: Missions (user dispatches to Zero), Delegation Events (Zero breaks down & assigns to Pro; Pro delegates subtasks to Jarvis/Aluna/Plus), Shared Room Chat messages (where all 5 agents communicate), Task Queue items with results, Channels configuration (WhatsApp, Facebook placeholders + real Internet Search integration via emergent LLM/web tool), and Zero Direct Chat.
5. SHARED ROOM & LIVE STREAMING: Build a dedicated agent chat room where messages and system delegation badges appear in chronological order with filter by agent.

6. EXTERNAL CHANNELS & REAL WEB SEARCH: Implement connection toggles for WhatsApp and Facebook (mocked/simulation with webhook/status indicators) AND a fully working Internet Search channel where Zero/Jarvis performs real web lookups and answers.
7. ZERO DIRECT SPACE: Dedicated 1-on-1 private chat interface with Zero simulating human boss communicating via phone/voice/chat.

8. BILINGUAL SUPPORT: Add a clean PT/EN toggle in the top header with instant i18n switching for all labels, placeholders, and tooltips, adhering to Brazilian Portuguese locale conventions by default.
9. AUTOMATED TESTING SUPPORT: Add unambiguous data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, channel switches, message boxes).
